1 SCRUM-893 paired display 600x1024.seen: Each of the four boxes opened the keys under it on a touch; typing with the keys reached the box and the till copy ~0.5-1.0 s after the last key (child name 995 ms, allergies 1010 ms, dietary 1022 ms, guardian 502 ms; poll granularity ~0.5 s). Owner case: allergy "Peanuts And Eggs" typed and on the till copy. Keys: Q-P, A-L, Z-M (26 capital letters), Backspace, Space, Done; no digits, no punctuation, no Thai.

2 SCRUM-894 600x1024 and 1024x600.seen: Every box: field and keys inside the scroll area, keys under the field, both above the bar; the field did not move while typing (0 px, scrollTop unchanged). Finding: a new step keeps the previous step's scroll, so Agreements can open with the guardian box hidden above (1024x600 one child; 600x1024 two children).

3 till customer half ?keyboard=screen.seen: All four boxes inputmode none and open the keys; allergies took 127 characters (maxlength 500) and the registration stored all 127.

4 SCRUM-914.seen: Half: tick -> Telegram -> WhatsApp = unticked; tick -> Backspace -> 0 typed back = unticked. Board: landline 21234567 refused under the field, Save disabled; new mobile: withdraw warning; PATCH 200 warnings[...withdrawn...]; toast says withdrawn; registration contactConfirmedAt/By cleared.

5 SCRUM-915 phone till 390x844.seen: Hand the phone to the customer -> Customer is ready -> the family form with camera, allergies, guardian, number tick, Still needed line, Done; wide bottom button "Return phone to staff". Done -> Review Order with Drop-off service ฿225; cash Z89302-000001 ฿915; one registration (one POST 200) with photo, in park. Return half-way: staff back at the gate (Children playing alone, Before payment list), nothing posted; reopening keeps what was typed; sale cancelled, nothing written.

6 SCRUM-942 lock lines.seen: Locked 120.2 s after the last touch; line 1 "A family is filling in the drop-off form on the display."; family Done -> display "Thank you. The team will be with you in a moment." in 0.5 s, lock line "The family has pressed Done: unlock to carry on." in 2.9 s; nothing posted while locked; unlock -> registration POST 200 and Amount Due ฿915.

7 SCRUM-943.seen: a) display: "No camera available · Reception will take the photo..."; till: "The display has no camera. Take each child's photo with the family here, in Private child details." (refused: "The camera on the display was refused. ..."). b) held write: display kept "Thank you — saving your details..." after staff Back; release -> one POST 200, cart carried the drop-off ฿915. c) typed 0898: both "+66 0898"; complete: display "+66 898930212", till copy "898930212 / Stored as +66898930212". d) line over the form in 0.5 s, no Retry, tick position unchanged; tick given offline reached the till ~1 s after online. e) copy buttons disabled at opacity 0.5. f) light: title rgb(146,64,14) / note rgba(59,40,28,.85) on a white .82 veil; dark: amber-300 title, note at half strength, no veil.

8 Thai journey 600x1024.seen: Two children, keys labelled in Thai (Space เว้นวรรค, Backspace ลบตัวอักษร, Done เสร็จสิ้น), letters English; cash ฿1830 Z89301-000004; both in park with photos. Untranslated at 600 wide: the park's three confirmation texts stay English; nothing cut or overlapping found.

9 nothing else moved.seen: Staff-filled drop-off with Continue (no keys without the flag): POST 200, cash Z89301-000005 ฿915, in park. Ordinary 1 kid + 1 adult: straight to payment, no form, no registration, cash Z89301-000006 ฿1040.
